rationale: Verified against disk before signing: the working-tree matured-approach.md is byte-identical to the copy at reviewed head 97becd3 (raw sha256 6bb8cf01...), CONVERGED.json records exactly plan_ref sha256:bb2ea18f... over the canonicalized candidate, and the cited evidence exists on disk (referee-adjudications/2026-08-28-e6-oracle-determinism.json marked ADVISORY; EYE-DIRECTIVES/2026-08-28-product-1-spikes-nonblocking.md honestly labeled a recorded directive, not a signed authorization; the 2026-08-28 S3-hold ruling binds the same unchanged plan_ref and mandates this durable-signature S2 rerun). Judged on the plan's own terms it is implementation-ready. (1) E1-E6 are genuinely fail-closed with adversarial regressions that reproduce each defect: the merge controller is the sole merge credential with per-merge re-derived eligibility, synthetic-merge-commit precedence, producer-authenticated checks (never name-keyed), Eye-signed pre-merge acceptance, serialized revalidate-then-merge closing same-run drift, and an honestly recorded trust-root non-claim for the (3)->(4) window; E2's base-anchored verifier closure, out-of-tree chain root, covered_files-binding transition signatures, custody-split environments, and Eye-local genesis close the self-authorization and bootstrap circularities; E3 is exceptionless; E4 flips the production default; E6's pure-evaluator ABI makes determinism structural rather than an isolation fight, with two-sided discrimination (mutation negatives + conforming positives), enforced domain cardinality, and an exhaustive deterministic battery. All of it honors the repo invariants: content-addressed enforcement identity, no mutable-label keying, closed sets, fail-closed defaults, zero-dep core. (2) The governance bootstrap correctly executes the successor-plan transition as a docs/registry-only slice under sitting v15 authority, with AM-42 bytes untouched and AM-43's two-phase authorize-then-activate preserving the exact-bijection inventory gates at the bootstrap head — this council's build_id naming the enrollment flip is the regularization, not a bypass. (4) The content-addressed input-closure + input-history digests resolve the run-2 freshness paradox without self-reference, and the union-discovery CI mode split closes the added/deleted-woven-file blind spots. CARRIED-FORWARD ITEMS — I RATIFY BOTH: (i) SPIKE-E6-EVALUATOR-FORM — deferring the concrete declarative grammar/evaluator form to a hard pre-implementation merge-gate on the oracle-hardening slice is acceptable: the soundness question is settled in-plan (a lookup-table oracle is structurally inexpressible in a declarative predicate surface with no imperative escape), the deferral is bounded to implementation form between two known-sound options, and per the recorded S3-hold ruling no normative oracle ships until the spike's adversarial conformance tests pass, with the interim source-review + battery correctly characterized as compensating controls, not soundness proof — a bounded, honestly-recorded spike with a fail-closed interim, not a contradiction; (ii) the open_questions_for_the_eye including product-1-oq-e6-determinism-deferral — the referee record is advisory and the deferral decision properly rests with the Eye; the §6b register's explicit refusal to self-authorize is exactly the right posture and I ratify the proposed dispositions. I found no remaining internal contradiction, no unsound design, and no over-claim: §8's non-claims (provenance-not-correctness, single-trust-principal honesty, Phase-1b scheduled-not-delivered) match what the mechanisms actually deliver. Out-of-scope deferrals (multi-engine qualification, self-contained npm distribution, Phase-1b identity/durability) are register-tracked with target rounds and were not conditioned on. Approve as-is.
